Description:
OHMIC RESISTORS designs, builds and tests indoor and outdoor neutral earthing resistors (Neutral grounding resistors) to suit our customer’s ratings and environmental locations. Designs are from 240V to 132kV and 2 Amperes to 10,000Amperes. Products comply with customer specifications inclusive of ANSI /IEEE Std32-1972 standard for neutral grounding devices. Neutral earthing resistors can be installed in indoor and outdoor enclosures providing protection ranging from IP00 to IP56. Designs can incorporate short time or extended time neutral fault currents in accordance with customer specifications, times typically from 0.5 to 60 seconds.
Enclosures can be suitable for connection at neutral and earthing connection locations with cable or bushings. Multiple earthing configurations, on load or off load isolating switches, neutral current transformers and enclosure heaters, as required by customer specification, can be incorporated in the end product. Enclosures can be designed for installations where space is limited. Enclosures, are manufactured utilizing Galvabond, powder coated mild steel, stainless steel or aluminium as required by customer. Designs are available for tropical and cyclonic locations.
At OHMIC RESISTORS, we manufacture Dynamic Braking Resistors with thermal ratings to suit customer requirements within resistor design criteria. Designs may be air natural or force air cooled. The purpose of a dynamic braking resistor is, when inserted into a motor or VFVV drive circuit, to slow down an electric motor and upstream equipment by converting kinetic energy into heat. The design of dynamic braking resistors depends on cyclic ratings of given systems, for example electric locomotives or mill drives.

A History Of Industry Leadership

Marathon started in 1913 as Marathon Electric in Wausau, Wisconsin, USA. In a converted logging mill on Plumer's Island, the young company made its first product, a single phase 115VAC, 1/4 horsepower washing machine motor.

After a few years as a fledgling motor manufacturer, inventor Austin Kimble took over as general manager. Kimble introduced new production methods and products based on his patents. With mixed results, Marathon's portfolio expanded into fans, talking movies, and metered washing machines. During the 1930s, the company reorganized as Marathon Electric Manufacturing Corporation and turned profits during the Great Depression.

Marathon expanded in the following decades. New production plants opened and Marathon purchased Pennsylvania-based Burke Electronics in 1949. This purchase allowed Marathon to enter into the generators, fuse, and terminal block fields.

Name: PyroPIP (International) : Pre-ignition Electrical Fire Prevention

In the world of fire safety,   PIP  is truly unique because it provides an unprecedented proactive solution to HRC/J related electrical fires which was innovated by David and Christine (Elaine) Heathcote (UK) the founders in December 2004 and later was further researched and developed for a manufacturing process by their overseas component manufacturers from 2006 with characteristics information being provided by David.

The  innovative technology behind PyroPIP allows it to activate at 85°C ±5° which is sufficiently above normal operating temperature to avoid nuisance activation, but well below the point at which smoke or ignition occurs. All other leading fire safety products currently available are reactive solutions, designed to limit the damage once a fire has started, be they sprinkler systems, fire alarms or fire extinguisher systems. 

PyroPIP was reformed in 2019 in Australia and is the champion of PIPtech solutions which is the trading name of the company.  We are responsible for the creation and development of an effective sales and marketing strategy for Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Spain, the USA,  and many other territories. 

PyroPIP's overall management and Head Office is now located in Australia and New Zealand and is no longer in the UK.  This is because opportunities and lawful conditions are far stricter and fairer, also the mission receives far better incentive and support under this new jurisdiction.  

PyroPIP is strongly committed to:

•	Increasing public awareness of PyroPIP and its life and property saving capabilities

Our focus is to help customers with their next technology innovation in the space of Automotive, Medical, Aerospace,  Defence, Communications, 
Computing, Power, Oil & Gas, and Industrial Automation. To enable the same, we have set up R&D centers, testing lab infrastructure, and world-class manufacturing facilities in India. 

Argus Engineering centers are equipped to handle complex and critical projects and programs for Hardware, Silicon, Software, and mechanical providing a virtual extension to the client’s development team.

We have a global clientele spread across the US, Canada, the UK, Germany, France, Norway, Sweden, Netherlands, Italy, Slovakia, Belgium, Switzerland, Australia, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Egypt, India, South Korea, China, Malaysia and Singapore.

Name: Centurion Systems
Description:
Centurion Systems (Pty) Ltd manufactures both the CENTURION and CENTSYS brands of products. These high quality access automation products include gate motors, traffic barriers, remote controls, keypads, proximity access control systems, intercoms, GSM switching devices and many more.

Accredited with the world class quality assurance system, ISO:9001, the company ensures that its products are manufactured to the highest level of quality and are tested to 100% of specification. 

The company invests considerably in its Research and Development programme employing a team of talented and experienced engineers.

The company’s manufacturing capability is world class and incorporates state-of-the-art processing including a virtually fully automated SMT facility and robotics.

Centurion Systems has a dedicated Exports department that caters for the needs of international customers in over fifty countries.

With hundreds of thousands of innovative and reliable CENTURION and CENTSYS operators installed around the world, these products have earned an enviable reputation of being The Automatic Choice amongst professional installers.

Name: Fronius Australia
Description:
The Fronius Business Unit (BU) Solar Energy has been developing photovoltaic energy solutions and distributing its products through a global network of expert installation, service and sales partners since 1992. More than 24 Solar Energy subsidiaries, an export ratio of over 95 percent and a total output of more than 17 Gigawatts from installed inverters are testament to this. Its mission is to achieve 24 hours of sun. Day after day Fronius is hard at work turning this vision of a future in which 100% of the world’s energy needs are covered by renewable sources into a reality. With this in mind, Fronius develops energy solutions to generate, store, distribute and consume solar energy economically and intelligently.

Fronius Australia is one of international subsidiaries of global, family-owned company Fronius International. Supplying the Australian market with solar inverters since the turn of the millennium Fronius was an early mover in Australian solar. Realising the long-term potential of solar in Australia a Solar Energy subsidiary was set up in Melbourne in 2010. With a presence including a local warehouse, technical support and a repair centre, Fronius Australia successfully serves as a regional hub for Australia and New Zealand in distribution, service and support of our inverter range. Global experience combined with strong local support thus ensure premium quality and reliability.

Name: Hammond Manufacturing
Description:
Hammond Manufacturing first began in a backyard workshop crafting metal parts. In the late 1910’s this humble family business began building tube-driven radios and amplifiers. In the years that followed, Hammond grew to become a recognized name in numerous industries including industrial, telecommunications and electronics. Today Hammond is today a leading designer, manufacturer and marketer of equipment racks and cabinets, industrial and electronic enclosures and power distribution devices.

The Hammond brand of products are widely used in many different applications and have been recognized as a brand that designs and manufactures their products to be durable and long-lasting. 

Hammond offers a diverse product line that includes electrical and electronic enclosures, power outlet strips, electronic transformers as well as equipment rack and cabinet solutions for audio-visual, pro-audio and data/comm applications.

Hammond is a publicly held company (TSX: HMM.A) headquartered in Guelph, Ontario, Canada with offices located in four countries, including major facilities in Canada, USA, and Europe. Hammond products are sold and supported through a worldwide network of authorized Hammond partners.

Name: Coolon LED Lighting
Description: Coolon is an Australian technology-driven manufacturer of advanced LED lighting systems, delivering its multi-award-winning Brilliant Connected Lights (BCL) platform globally. Recognised as Australian Manufacturer of the Year, Coolon designs and manufactures in Australia solutions for mining, heavy industry, ports, and marine environments - forming a distributed digital backbone that extends beyond illumination. Coolon’s range of industrial lights spans across some of the harshest and most demanding applications in the world, alongside an architectural portfolio that transforms landscapes into iconic night-time identities - distinctive, enduring, and recognised for generations.

Name: Sensear
Description:
Occupational Hearing Loss Is One of The Most Common Work-Related Illnesses, Costing an Estimated $242 Million in Annual U.S. Workers’ Compensation (CDC)

Sensear’s innovative noise cancelling headsets coupled with our patented situational awareness capability and proprietary face-to-face communication technology supports companies focused on protecting their business and employees.

Sensear is a global leader in designing and manufacturing best-in-class digital communication headsets used by some of the world's leading companies in their mission to eradicate hearing loss and enhance operational critical communications. Sensear collaborates with industries in high-noise environments, as well as leading communications manufacturers to help solve high-workplace noise and communication challenges.

Founded in 2006 through a partnership with the University of Western Australia and Curtin University to provide mining companies with headsets that protect hearing, allow users to verbally communicate, and retain 360° situational awareness. Driven by industry demand, Sensear headsets are equipped with our proprietary SENS Technology, which simultaneously provides Speech Enhancement and Noise Suppression, allowing all senses to work better together.

Sensear’s portfolio of over-the-ear and in-the-ear headsets represents a paradigm shift in the way people communicate in noisy environments, revolutionizing workplace communication in oil, gas, mining, construction, manufacturing, data centers, concerts, special events, and other industrial workplaces. Sensear’s ISO 9001:2015 certification demonstrates its commitment to design, manufacture, and repair products to meet our customers' high-quality standards.
Sensear designs and manufactures its headsets in-house at its Perth, Australia headquarters and distributes products from its U.S. headquarters outside of Chicago.

What Is Hearing Protection Worth to Your Business? To Your Employees?

Name: Qlite Global
Description:
Qlite Limited UK is an established company with specialisation in low voltage control systems. Qlite designs and manufactures LED Display Videowall, state-of-the-art Guest Room management systems (GRMS), plug-in Dimming controls, Lighting control, Home Automation systems, Architectural Lighting Solutions Daylight Harvesting systems, Sensors and Wiring accessories.

With more than 20 years of presence, Qlite is respected and recognised around the world with engineering capabilities to meet any market standards and custom-made products. We have many years of experience working as a professional partner to electrical consultants and contractors, architects and lighting designers.

Qlite, supported by its strong R&D, caters to the ever-changing needs of the lighting industry. It boasts of an up-to-date product range comprising
well tested and proven LED control gear, LED dimmers and latest smart Tablet PCs/devices.

Hemisphere holds numerous patents and other intellectual property and sells globally with several leading product, service, and technology brands including AthenaTM, Atlas, Crescent, EclipseTM, Outback Guidance, and VectorTM for high-precision applications. Hemisphere is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ, USA, with offices located around the globe.

Name: Zip Water
Description:
Zip Water has been manufacturing and marketing Australian designed and made instant water systems since 1947. With unrivalled expertise in filtered boiling, chilled and sparkling water taps, Zip Water is known globally for being home to the world’s most advanced drinking water appliances.

Name: TECO Australia & New Zealand
Description:
TECO is an engineering-driven technology manufacturer delivering electric motors, drives, home appliances and air conditioning and energy solutions designed for demanding industrial and commercial environments.
In Australia and New Zealand, TECO operates as a technical partner to industry, providing reliable equipment and application expertise across manufacturing, mining, utilities, infrastructure and buildings.

Rather than simply supplying products, TECO supports customers with complete electrical motion and energy solutions that keep critical assets running efficiently and predictably.

Our portfolio spans:
Electric motors (LV and MV)
Variable speed drives
Soft starters
Power infrastructure (transformers, busway)
Home appliances and air conditioning solutions

Engineering credibility
TECO solutions are designed around real operating conditions.
Products are engineered to perform in harsh industrial environments and Australian operating conditions.

Reliability of critical assets
TECO equipment is designed to protect the continuity of operations.
Motors, drives and power systems are often installed in applications where failure is not acceptable.

Lifecycle value
Customers buy TECO for efficiency, durability, maintainability and long-term operating cost control.

Practical integration

Motors
Drives
Starting systems
Power distribution

This allows engineers to specify integrated electrical solutions rather than isolated components.

Partnership with industry
TECO works closely with:
engineers
EPC contractors
OEMs
installers
distributors

The goal is to support specification decisions, installation and long-term operation.

Name: Minelab Metal Detectors
Description:
To the treasure hunter, the gold prospector, the protector: We know your quest. 

Minelab detectors are engineered for discovery. In fact, our R&D team is 50 engineers strong. That’s what makes our hand-held metal detection technology the best in the world. It has been for 35 years. We don’t plan to surrender that title anytime soon.

We welcome the challenge of ‘difficult’ terrain. Magnetic minerals, iron-rich soil and deep water are no match for our innovation. You will see deeper with a Minelab detector than any other on the market. 

Minelab’s dealer network and operations span the globe: Australia, Europe, Middle East, Asia and the Americas. Our dealers are adventurers, hunters and prospectors just like you. No matter where you detect, they are ready to answer questions, suggest sites and celebrate your successes.  

Every product that bears the Minelab badge is built rugged and precise. We’re ISO 9001 Certified and we manufacture to military-grade standards. It’s why military forces around the world trust our detectors to locate life-threatening landmines. Miners in Africa make life-changing gold discoveries with our detectors. And treasure hunters worldwide use our detectors to unearth history, from rare relics to ancient coin hoards. We know your quest and our detectors are precisely engineered to find the fortune you seek.  

With Minelab, you’ll find performance is everything. 

Minelab is a division of Codan Limited, an international leader in innovative technology solutions with customers in over 150 countries.

Name: APS Industrial
Description:
At APS Industrial, we’re the gateway that connects the world’s leading industrial manufacturers to the local industry. With exclusive local access to the market’s broadest portfolio of industrial low and medium voltage electrical and automation products, we offer a true one stop shop the that promises, simplicity, security and connectivity.

Our quality product range is made possible by our distribution agreements with leading global manufacturers. Central to this is our exclusive master distribution agreement with Siemens.

To complete our range of core brands we have key distribution agreements with Weidmüller, Rittal, Belden and KATKO. In addition to our core range of brands, APS Industrial also connects the local market with complementary brands and ranges to form a complete product and solutions offering.

In an industry landscape rapidly transforming through digitalisation, quality and a competitive edge matter. APS Industrial is the new choice the gives you both.

Description:

Toshiba (Australia) Pty Limited is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Toshiba TEC. It was founded in 1975 and covers Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific Islands, including Papua New Guinea. It is comprised of the following divisions:

Name: Tlou Energy Ltd
Description:
Tlou Energy is an AIM, ASX and BSE listed company focused on electricity generation in Botswana and the broader southern African region through the development of power projects.

Botswana has a significant energy shortage and generally relies on imported power and diesel generation to fulfill its power requirements. Tlou’s plan provides investors with access to a compelling opportunity to displace expensive, carbon intensive coal and diesel fired electricity with a more environmentally friendly alternative.

In addition to plans for cleaner energy, the Company is also committed to developing community projects in Botswana adding real value to peoples’ lives in a region with sparse services and where few opportunities exist for the local population. The Company aims to assist communities to become self-sustaining, develop business opportunities, build schools, get access to medical professionals and create employment.

Name: Valen Power
Description:
Valen are an End-to-End Solution Provider of Industrial Batteries & Energy Storage and have been 'Powering Potential' across Australia & New Zealand for the past 25 Years. Tell us about your requirements as well as your issues and challenges. We'll provide you with assistance so you can make that final decision with confidence.

Description:
Since 1955, B&R Enclosures has partnered with Australian industries and communities to deliver reliable, purpose-built enclosures, cabinets, and integrated electrical solutions that perform in the world’s toughest conditions.

Proudly 100% Australian and family-owned, we’re driven by a simple promise: to protect what matters most - your people, your equipment, and your infrastructure.

B&R has supported customers across mining, energy, transport, telecommunications, industrial, commercial, and residential sectors with proven engineering expertise, precision manufacturing, and local service that delivers results.

With manufacturing facilities in Brisbane, Adelaide, and Sydney, supported by national sales and warehousing and operations in China and Saudi Arabia B&R combines global reach with responsive, local service.

As a third-generation Australian family business, our strength lies in our people, our experience, and our commitment to building smarter, safer, and stronger solutions. From precision sheet metal fabrication to fully integrated electrical systems - we’re more than manufacturers. We’re your solution partners.

Name: Eagle Lighting
Description:
Eagle Lighting proudly offers high-quality, customisable, innovative, and sustainable lighting solutions to the commercial, healthcare, educational and critical infrastructure markets. Combining our leading-edge research and knowledgeable people, we can deliver outstanding outcomes for all lighting projects. We are passionate about collaborating with our clients to help them find the best lighting solution for their unique projects – carefully considering everyone, from the varied project stakeholders to the end-users. We pride ourselves on our in-house design, testing, and manufacturing of customisable luminaires, all from our state-of-the-art facility in Melbourne. We understand that providing the best lighting solutions requires expert consultation and lighting design, quality products and outstanding customer service. So when you choose Eagle Lighting, you don’t just get high quality lighting. You get a high standard of service and ongoing support. As a Fagerhult Group company, our access to global experts and products offers a combined capability unmatched in Australia.

RCR Infrastructure is a leading provider of electrical, communications, HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning), fire protection and property services and products across the Asia-Pacific region. Through a network of highly successful and long-established companies including O’Donnell Griffin, Haden and Resolve FM, the business has more than 3,300 employees across Australia and New Zealand.

Name: TTK
Description:
TTK is a global leader in digital liquid leak detection systems, engineering and manufacturing advanced solutions for over 35 years. Our smart sense cables detect water, hydrocarbons, acids, and the latest liquid cooling fluids used in high-density data centers.

Founded in France in 1989, TTK’s headquarters, R&D center, and manufacturing facilities are based in Paris. Our global presence spans subsidiaries and offices in London, Frankfurt, Philadelphia, Seattle, Los Angeles, Chicago, Ottawa, Dubai, Mumbai, Hong Kong, Singapore, and beyond. All products are made in France, certified by international standards including UL, FM, IEC, and ATEX, and trusted by tens of thousands of clients worldwide.

Our flagship FG-NET system offers real-time leak location accuracy (±1m), full compatibility with all TTK cables, BMS/SCADA integration, and a 7” touchscreen interface—delivering comprehensive protection for data centers, critical facilities, and commercial infrastructure.

As specialized manufacturers, we deliver tailored, reliable solutions—aligned with your project, budget, and timeline.

Name: Lafert Group
Description:
We are an international group leader in the designing and manufacturing of ELECTRIC MOTORS AND DRIVES with over 60 years of experience and solid collaborations with international players, leaders in their sectors.

We have developed innovative solutions based on permanent magnet technology with VERY HIGH EFFICIENCY IE5-IE6, and in more recent time MOTOR-DRIVE PACKAGES for maximum performance control. Our evolution does not stop, it continues to grow towards an increasingly strong electrification of machines and applications with "endless integrated solutions".

Together we will expand our product portfolio with the most sophisticated expertise in design and the most modern production capacity, even in integrated solutions.

Further information, including postings of the most recent product and technology announcements, is available by visiting the HDcctv Alliance Web site at www.highdefcctv.org.

Name: Altro Power Systems
Description:
Altro Transformers is a specialist in the engineering and manufacture of electrical transformers, power quality systems and packaged power systems for commercial and utility solar projects.  
With over 30 years of experience, our range incorporates a combination of LV and MV products:
•	Control Transformers  
•	Single and Three Phase Isolation & Auto Transformers
•	MV Oil Immersed and Dry Type transformers and packaged substations 
•	PFC - Power Factor Correction  
•	AHF - Active Harmonic Filters
•	VPO - Voltage Power Optimisation

CEC’s minespec Transformer Oil Filtration unit and 4WD service truck travel the East Coast of Australia servicing councils, mines & industrial clients. CEC are experts in HV installation and maintenance, and onsite Transformer Oil Filtration forms part of CEC’s overall HV maintenance.

Onsite Transformer Oil Filtration restores the oil to its new state. The filtration process removes acidity, sludge and soluble oil decay products from the transformer windings and cooling system.

The filtration process lowers operating temperatures of the transformer, which helps prevent recontamination. The desired outcome of onsite Transformer Oil Filtration is to maintain the insulating properties of the Transformer Oil. This can be achieved with the optimum seven year cycle. This will allow the integrity of the transformer oil to remain intact and prevent costs by not only increasing the life of the transformer, but also reducing the probability of an unplanned outage.

Name: Aldora Electric Company
Description:
Aldora engineers, supplies, and commissions electrical power systems for critical infrastructure across Australia.

From specification through to energisation, we are accountable for the outcome.

Why we exist
Most electrical infrastructure projects don't fail because any single party did their job poorly. They fail at the interfaces — where the specifier hands to the supplier, where the supplier hands to the installer, where the installer hands to commissioning.

Each interface is a place where accountability breaks down and risk accumulates. By the time issues surface at energisation, the window to fix them effectively has closed.

Aldora owns the interfaces. We are the one firm in Western Australia that engineers the specification, supplies the system, and commissions the outcome.

What we do

ENGINEER — Power systems design, grid compliance, protection engineering, commissioning planning, and owner's electrical engineering

SUPPLY — MV and HV cable, conductors, OPGW, and specialist accessories from leading global manufacturers

COMMISSION — Test management, interface management, energisation oversight, grid code testing, and protection verification

Who we work with
Project owners, EPCs, utilities, mining operators, and data centre developers — wherever reliability is critical and failure is not an option. Our clients include Siemens Gamesa, Iberdrola, ABB, Genus, Rio Tinto, Newmont, Mott MacDonald, UGL, and Horizon Power.

Proof
We led commissioning of the Carnarvon Microgrid, demonstrating 100% renewable energy penetration. We delivered the Smithfield BESS outage two weeks early, restoring firming capacity to the Sydney grid. We are part of the Clean Energy Council, and ISO 9001 certified.

DC Power Supplies
A power supply is often taken for granted as it is seen as an insignificant part of equipment. For most it is just an electronic box ordered at the last moment. However, a power supply can be compared to our heart; It’s often neglected and we tend to pay more attention to our hair. Yet if the heart fails, the system goes down.

Design concept
Delta power supplies have a reputation of being remarkably reliable. Therefore our design concept puts a strong emphasis on long lifetime and excellent technical specifications. The specifications of our products may seem unrealistic at first, but when measured they turn out to be even better as defined. Delta users expect perfection, an almost infinite life time at continuous full power and low cost of ownership. Ongoing research makes it possible to produce products that can meet these ever increasing demands.

Result
As a result of our design philosophy the units react more than 10 times faster on load transients, produce hardly audible noise and produce 10 – 30 times less electromagnetic interference. Delta customers will never face any problems due to radiated or conducted emissions of our power supplies. The same design philosophy applies for immunity: the toughest standard is not good enough for us. A Delta power supply will always operate reliable, even in a very noisy environment.All our power supply units are thoroughly tested before being dispatched to the customer.This ensures long term correct functioning of each unit and client satisfaction. Delta Elektronika produces world class DC power supplies.

Description:

KNX - THE WORLDWIDE STANDARD FOR HOME AND BUILDING CONTROL

KNX is the world’s only truly open protocol endorsed by worldwide standards. KNX is not manufacturer specific. It is open protocol and all aspects of KNX are managed by the KNX Association in Brussels. Based on the strict testing standards and protocols established by the association all KNX products are guaranteed to be interoperable, irrespective of the manufacturer and product type.

KNX Australia (KNX National Group Ltd) was formed by a group of manufacturers, integrators, associations and training establishments along with other interested parties to promote the KNX standard within the Australian market.

Governed by an elected board, KNX Australia is a collective of active KNX advocates whose experience reflects KNX activities within Australia. The website is one of the key focuses of the organisation and its activities, outlining the basics of the KNX standard and providing visibility to its members via the members’ directory.

All members of KNX Australia have agreed to abide by a Code of Conduct and act in the best interests of promoting the KNX Standard. There are currently two levels of membership – Full Membership and Associate Membership.

In November 2017, KNX Standard – IS0/IEC 14543-3 (Parts 1-6) was adopted as an Australian Technical Standard by Standards Australia. This formal recognition and endorsement provide confidence to both KNX Association members and the clients they serve, about the quality of standard KNX can bring to their next project.

KNX Australia is part of a network of national associations who are all members of the international KNX Association, based in Brussels.

The KNX Association has a vast worldwide membership from major manufacturers, integrators, training schools, academic institutions and other interested parties. Around the world there are over 420 KNX Manufacturer members, over 77,000 KNX Partners and 446 KNX Training Centres in 68 Countries.

Name: iEP2 Group Pty Limited
Description:
iEP2 has invented and developed intelligent and innovative earth leakage electrical safety switches, which isolate in both earthed and non-earthed circuits to better protect people and assets when compared with other technologies.
Uniquely, iEP2’s iFS technology integrated with conventional RCD/RCBO technologies into one-device, automatically isolate whether or not there is a viable earth or functioning RCD mechanism.
Significantly, this unique integration enables iEP2’s iFS/RCD/RCBO safety device to prevent all electrical shocks, including the debilitating 30 mA electrical shock which can occur with the conventional RCD/RCBO when there is no viable earth or a faulty RCD mechanism.
It is well documented that a residual 30 milliamp shock, can be harmful, and if left unattended cause both short and long term physical and mental injury: many who suffer a 30 mA earth leakage electric shock may never get to a hospital or medical practitioner for timely medical intervention (and never report the event).
Not only does iEP2’s technology have important global health and safety benefits and a re-writing of industry safety standards, but it is designed to also deliver better and more cost-effective maintenance, system management and device monitoring. 
Nobody should ever be exposed to the risk of contact with even a fault current delivering a 30 mA shock.
Unlike conventional RCD’s, iEP2’s technology has a zero fault current tolerance strategy and designed to be one step ahead of an earth leakage event to isolate a circuit whether or not there is a viable path to earth.

Cable ties, zip ties, hose ties, zap straps or tie wraps - no matter what you call them, they are a useful and cheap tool with a myriad of uses.

There are cable ties for every conceivable application - from mining to agriculture, electrical to commercial uses - the cable tie has become a necessary part of a diverse range of industries.

Our nylon cable ties are one of our most popular products and really are in a league of their own. They are made of high quality, European standard Nylon 6/6, devoid of any metal parts making them both strong and stable in harsh environments. They have a flammability rating of UL 94 Class V2, compliant with MIL Requirements S-23190. These tough, rigid, and highly stable nylon cable ties can withstand even the severest of conditions. Our closures are manufactured with no metal parts so they are completely safe for electrical use.

Our range of polyamide cable ties includes a variety of sizes and strengths, in a choice of natural or black. The smallest (98 x 2.5 mm) comes with a minimum tensile strength of 8.16 kg; and the largest (720 x 12.6 mm) can support up to 110 kg. Smooth edges mean you don't have to worry about damage to your valuable equipment, and the secure fastening mechanism means you can bundle your wires quickly with no risk of slipping. Our range of black cable ties are recommended for outdoor use as they are more resistant to ultraviolet light.

One of the benefits of using cable ties for more traditional purposes is that there are a variety of marking options available to assist with identifying your pipes, wires or cables for future reference. Save time and keep your workplace safe by checking out our range of cable tie compatible sleeves, or contact us for a quote to utilise our custom marking service. As well as marking options, we provide adhesive bases in two sizes and both black and natural colours.

Carry US Military Specifications MIL-DTL-203050/4
Provide a positive join or termination by mechanical compression (crimp) of tinned copper or brass barrels and a chemical seal created by shrinkage/adhesive flow induced by heat application to the polyolefin tube.
Prevent moisture wicking along wire and provide strain relief
Are available in a diverse range of sizes and shapes.
Are easy to use and are suitable for all stranded wire ranging from 8AWG (8.3mm2) down to 24AWG (0.2mm2).
Heat shrink terminals in the past have often been inconsistent of quality, available in a very limited range and priced outrageously.
These factors often precluded their use even in extreme conditions of moisture, temperature, pollution or vibration, leading to both wire degradation and terminal failure when cheaper automotive type terminals were used.
The aim of Superior Terminals is to change that situation. We sell quality items directly to major users thereby eliminating supply chain imposts which inflate prices. This also allows us to focus on providing the highest level of customer service possible.

Our product line consists solely of terminals, associated tools and a range of specialised heat shrink tubing. This enables us to carry a stock level of over 160,000 terminals covering over 60 individual lines including over a kilometer of 3M heat shrink tubing in various types.
Stock levels are maintained by air from NSPA on a regular basis and items not normally stocked can be sourced from the US by expediated air freight in four to five days.

The Ozilite Range- Automatic Cigarette Lighter

Product Description
The Ozilite Automatic Cigarette Lighter is a lighting device that has a recessed heating element and no naked flame with the purpose of lighting cigarettes. This device was designed for use in any environment that a naked flame can not exist or where conventional cigarette lighters or matches are not permitted.

Locations
Initially the device was designed for use in maximum-security correctional facilities where cigarettes are allowed, and for security purposes access to lighters and matches are prohibited. However the Ozilite products have proven to be effective in many other environments as well. This device is a flush wall mounted unit; the face plate is made of stainless steel and is liquid proof. There are six security screws (as used in maximum-security correctional facilities) which mount the unit.

Heating Cycle ( Timer Models )
The heating cycle of the Ozilite Automatic Cigarette Lighter works once the button is pushed; the element will heat for 10 seconds and then the timer circuit will prevent the re-activation of the element again for another 10 seconds. These times can also be changed to suit your environment.

Voltages
The Ozilite is available in both 110 volt and 240 volt models. We can also supply the Ozilite in 12 and 24 volt versions.

Name: Bondline Static Control Solutions Pty Ltd
Description:
Thank you for visiting Bondline Static Control Solutions Pty Ltd online ... your partner and specialist in all things Antistatic, Conductive, Dissipative and Static Control.

Complimenting that, we not only have a great range of production aids such as vision systems, fume extraction and tools, the vast majority of which are static safe, but also offer static awareness training / seminars, consulting and testing / audits.

We have been servicing a wide range of industries around Australasia & New Zealand since the last century... well 1999... and we continue to expand our knowledge, products & services to best enable us to best enable you.

We service and support our clients with their control / prevention of electrostatic issues at every point through manufacture, service, rework, repair, application, OH&S, logistics, contamination, training, audit, monitoring, etc.

Typically we are involved in a vast array of industries, e.g. Electronics, Defence, Aerospace, Mining, Medical, Pharmaceutical, Automotive, Aerosol, Printing, Converting, Semiconductor, Robotics, Building, Packaging, R&D, Production, Plastics, Telecommunications, Automation, Pyrotechnics, Hazardous Environments, Cleanrooms... in fact, anywhere where ‘static’ is an issue.

Here’s a thought...  static electricity is an amazing phenomenon, it not only attracts, repels and  induces voltage, but an ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) event emits EMI (Electromagnetic Interference), and that also causes many problems, e.g. computer lock-up and errors. 

So, having effective static control can be your solution to many and varied issues.

Bondline Static Control Solutions Pty Ltd, your Partner in Static Control.

Name: LCMS Australia Pty Ltd
Description:
The breakdown of high voltage insulators that is caused by conductive deposits on the insulators' surfaces can result in a flashover - especially under conditions of high humidity. This can cause significant damage to the electricity transmission infrastructure. Such contamination results from the deposit of contaminants from the atmosphere due to airborne pollution particles, and ocean salt spray.

LCMS Australia engages in the development and manufacture of specialised instrumentation to provide condition monitoring of High Voltage (HV) and Extremely High Voltage (EHV) electrical transmission line insulators.

We aim to provide the most advanced technology for real time on-line monitoring of conductive pollution deposited on HV and EHV insulators (insulator surface leakage). Design services for a conditioning monitoring system are provided.

An insulator monitoring system comprises several components :

  •  a Remote instrumentation unit (monitoring up to three insulators) with local power supply,
  •  a general purpose professional temperature and humidity instrument sub-system,
  •  a Base station computer with WiFi/GSM/3G/4G/M2M communications facilities including antenna, and
  •  LCMS system software suite for the Base station unit.

The LCMS remote unit is a robust, well-protected highly functional embedded processor instrument that is used for specialised test, measurement and control applications.

Phase Changer designs, manufactures and distributes Single Phase to 3 Phase electrical power converters. Manufacturing is in Australia.

Have you ever wanted to run a three phase powered machine, but you only have a single phase power supply available?

The Phase-Changer three phase converter changes a 240V or 480V single phase supply into an equivalent 415V 3-phase output, which is just like a utility 3 phase supply. It will efficiently operate any 3 phase equipment.

ANY MACHINE, ANY APPLICATION

Provided you have adequate single phase power available, there is always a Phase-Changer 3 phase converter solution that will reliably power any 3 phase machine. Workshop equipment, welders, compressors, pumps, computer controlled machines, air conditioners, in fact anything that requires 3 phase power can be operated by a Phase-Changer converter. Even big "hard to start" loads will start & run reliably with power from a Phase- Changer.

Your local electrician simply connects the input to your single phase supply via a new circuit breaker. And just like standard utility 3 phase, the output is connected to your machinery - and that's it - you're ready to go!

Compare the cost of a Phase-Changer to the cost of connecting to a utility power supply, and in most cases the Phase-Changer will cost far less. And you own it. It can be relocated or resold if your circumstances ever change.

We supply companies, such as Eaton, Emerson, Eltek, Oerlikon Batteries, Yuasa Batteries, Century Batteries, Alcatel, Saft  and many others.

All of our Load Banks are “Electronic loads”, i.e. rather than the basic Resistive Load Banks. All of our loads have constant current and have option for Constant Power, Resistance and Voltage.  They may be used for discharging batteries and are also used to test Telecom rectifiers.  The Load bank forms an Electrical load which draws power from the DC Power Source. 

We also build Data Loggers to monitor cells or monoblocks during battery discharge.  These units may also be used for remote monitoring Alarm over WAN, Ethernet (the web).

Philosophy
Our philosophy for making any product including load banks is that the basic design must be simple and very robust (both physically and electrically). We target our products to do exactly what the "end customer" requires and no more. We provide Customers with a cost effective solution to their requirements, so that their project can be completed on time and within budget. Because our products are very reliable, we keep our customers happy in that there are no on-going worries with the equipment. It is intended to be "fit and forget", i.e. no problems and no down time.

QA Program.
In 2004 we gained certification for Quality Assured Company by AS /NZS ISO 9001:2000.  Once our products have been built they then undergo rigorous testing. Then electrical safety tests are performed.  After this they are given a burn-in period to cause maximum stress and thermal cycling to the various components. The units are QA inspected again then they are given a final QA test. Documented test results for each unit are recorded and filed.

Name: ilineapp PTY LTD
Description:
iline Pilot was born on a rainy night in Perth, Australia.  Our founder, John was riding home on a freeway. Bad weather, dark roads, strict speed limits. Every few seconds his eyes dropped to the speedo — off the road, off the rain, off what mattered.

He thought: why doesn't something simple exist that just tells me if I'm okay?  

He searched. He found nothing affordable, nothing simple, nothing built for this one problem. Everything was too expensive, too complicated, or created new distractions of its own.  So he went home and started drawing.  Working out of his garage, no relevant degree no startup background, just a rider who was fed up — he built the first prototype. Then the second. Now the third.

iline Pilot is a small, simple speed alert device for motorbike riders. It attaches to your helmet, monitors your speed, and alerts you with lights when you're near or over the limit. No complicated setup. Just the one thing riders actually need: the freedom to keep their eyes on the road. 

We're two people from IT backgrounds who had no business building a hardware device. We did it anyway because the problem was real and the solution was obvious. We just had to make it.  We're currently preparing our first production run and launching globally.

If you ride or if someone you love does – iline Pilot is for you. 
Eyes on the road. Always.

the liquid, each particle becomes charged with the
same positive charge. Again using the basic
principle that opposites attract and similar charges
repel, the particles are naturally repelled by one
another, and freely break apart or atomize. This is
the primary concept that allows for a more even
coating.

methods.

gives a more even, full coat compared other
